verdict.rationale: Galileo is a SaaS AI observability and evaluation platform that ingests customer traces and datasets, so a policy or control preventing that data from being used to train AI models is a fair question for this kind of product. Nothing in the evidence pack addresses training-data use, opt-outs, or data-retention or privacy controls. The closest items, about distilling evals into Luna models and building datasets from production data, describe features and say nothing about vendor training policy.
